name: tax-register-core
description: Local state of Ukrainian software cash registers (PRRO): context, document journal, offline session rules and shift totals. Plain TypeScript, no framework dependencies.

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const dir of ['dist', '.test']) require('fs').rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && jasmine --config=jasmine.json
